territorial_scope.description: Applies to activities using facial recognition technology to process facial information within the PRC.

evidence.quote: These Measures apply to activities using facial recognition technology to process facial information within the People's Republic of China (PRC).

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Regulates the use of facial recognition technology to process facial information within the PRC, setting purpose, notice, consent, impact assessment, storage, minors and filing duties for processors, with supervision by cyberspace authorities. Effective 1 June 2025.
summary.long: The Measures regulate using facial recognition technology to process facial information within the PRC, excluding processing for research, development and algorithm training. Processors must have a specific purpose and sufficient necessity, and must give prior notice of listed matters. Where consent is the basis, it must be separate and voluntary, and withdrawal must be possible by convenient means; guardian consent is required for under-14s, who also need dedicated rules. Facial information is stored in recognition devices and not transmitted externally unless laws permit or separate consent is obtained, and retention is limited to the necessary minimum. A personal information protection impact assessment is required before use and again on purpose changes or major security incidents. Facial recognition may not be the sole identity verification method where alternatives exist, and misleading or coercing individuals into accepting it is prohibited. Installation in public spaces must be necessary for public security and signposted, and is barred in private areas of public places. Processors holding facial information of 100,000 individuals must file with a provincial-level or higher cyberspace administration within 30 business days. Regulators supervise and receive complaints. Violations are handled under other laws, with criminal liability where a crime is constituted. The text sets no fine amounts. Effective 1 June 2025.

notes: Registry title differs from the document title; the document title is used. The text gives no adoption date; Article 20 sets entry into force on June 1, 2025. Relations cover only the four instruments named in Article 1. Generic references to other laws and administrative regulations (Arts. 5, 6, 8, 10, 18) and to relevant national regulations on graded protection (Art. 14) name no instrument and are not coded. Target instrument IDs are empty because registry IDs were not supplied. Entity lei and ticker are empty because the text gives no identifiers. Spot-check: the cached text is the CSET English translation, so text_version.language is en and quotes are English. Art. 11 (encouraged use of national identity channels) names no addressee and is not coded as an obligation.

An organization or individual that independently determines the purpose and method of personal information processing activities.
Biometric information related to the facial features of an identified or identifiable natural person, recorded electronically or by other means; does not include anonymized information.
Biometric feature recognition technology that uses facial information to distinguish an individual’s identity.
A terminal device that uses facial recognition technology to distinguish an individual’s identity.
A one-to-one comparison of collected facial information with stored facial information in an information system to confirm whether the two match and refer to the same individual.
A “one-to-many” comparison of collected facial information with facial information stored within a specific scope in an information system

obligations.summary: Before using facial recognition to process facial information, inform individuals in a prominent manner of the processor's name and contact, purpose, method and retention period, necessity and impact, and rights procedures; notify individuals of any changes.
obligations.applies_from: Before using facial recognition technology to process facial information

evidence.quote: Before using facial recognition technology to process facial information, personal information processors shall, in a prominent manner and in clear, easy-to-understand language, truthfully, accurately, and fully inform individuals of the following

obligations.summary: Use facial recognition only for a specific purpose with sufficient necessity, adopting the method that minimizes impact on individuals' rights and interests, and implement strict protection measures.

evidence.quote: shall have a specific purpose and sufficient necessity, adopt the method that minimizes the impact on the rights and interests of individuals

obligations.summary: Where processing is based on individual consent, obtain it separately and voluntarily under fully informed circumstances; written consent where laws require it.

evidence.quote: such consent must be obtained separately and voluntarily under fully informed circumstances

obligations.summary: Provide a convenient and fast means for individuals to withdraw consent; withdrawal does not affect prior processing.

evidence.quote: Personal information processors shall provide a convenient and fast means for withdrawing consent.

obligations.summary: For facial information of minors under 14 processed on consent, obtain consent from the minor's parents or other guardians.
obligations.conditional_on: facial information of a minor under 14 processed on individual consent

evidence.quote: consent must be obtained from the minor’s parents or other guardians

obligations.summary: For facial information of minors under 14, formulate dedicated processing rules for storage, use, transfer and disclosure, and lawfully safeguard it.
obligations.conditional_on: processing facial information of minors under 14

evidence.quote: shall formulate dedicated processing rules for the storage, use, transfer, and disclosure of such information

obligations.summary: Unless laws or regulations provide otherwise or separate individual consent is obtained, store facial information within facial recognition devices and do not transmit it externally via the internet.
obligations.conditional_on: absence of laws or administrative regulations otherwise providing, and of separate individual consent

evidence.quote: facial information shall be stored within facial recognition devices and shall not be transmitted externally via the internet

obligations.summary: Unless laws or regulations provide otherwise, facial information retention shall not exceed the minimum duration necessary for the processing purpose.
obligations.conditional_on: absence of laws or administrative regulations otherwise providing

evidence.quote: the retention period for facial information shall not exceed the minimum duration necessary to achieve the purpose of processing

obligations.summary: Conduct a personal information protection impact assessment in advance covering lawfulness and necessity, impact on rights, leakage and misuse risks, and proportionality of measures; repeat it on change of purpose or method or after a major security incident.
obligations.applies_from: In advance of applying facial recognition technology

evidence.quote: shall conduct a personal information protection impact assessment in advance

obligations.summary: Keep records of processing activities; retain the impact assessment report and processing records for at least three years.

evidence.quote: The personal information protection impact assessment report and the processing records shall be retained for at least three years

obligations.summary: Where equivalent non-facial methods exist, do not use facial recognition as the sole means of identity verification; where an individual does not consent, provide other reasonable, convenient and fast alternatives.
obligations.conditional_on: other methods exist that achieve the same purpose or equivalent business requirements

evidence.quote: facial recognition technology shall not be used as the sole means of identity verification

obligations.summary: Do not mislead, defraud or coerce individuals into accepting facial recognition identity verification on grounds of business processing or service quality.

evidence.quote: No organization or individual shall mislead, defraud, or coerce individuals into accepting identity verification via facial recognition technology

obligations.summary: Installation of facial recognition equipment in public spaces must be necessary for public security; the collection area must be lawfully and reasonably defined and clear signage displayed.
obligations.conditional_on: installation of facial recognition equipment in public spaces

evidence.quote: clear signage must be displayed

obligations.summary: Do not install facial recognition equipment inside private areas of public places, such as hotel guest rooms, public baths, changing rooms or restrooms.

evidence.quote: No organization or individual shall install facial recognition equipment inside private areas of public places

obligations.summary: Adopt measures such as data encryption, security audits, access controls, authorization management, intrusion detection and prevention; fulfil graded cybersecurity protection and critical information infrastructure obligations where applicable.

evidence.quote: Systems applying facial recognition technology shall adopt measures such as data encryption, security audits, access controls

obligations.summary: File with the provincial-level or higher cyberspace administration with basic information, purpose and method, quantity and protection measures, processing rules, and the impact assessment report; file amendments on substantive changes within 30 business days and cancellation on termination within 30 business days.
obligations.applies_from: Within 30 business days from the date the stored volume reaches 100,000 individuals
obligations.conditional_on: volume of stored facial information reaches 100,000 individuals

evidence.quote: shall, within 30 business days from that date, complete filing procedures with the local cyberspace administration (网信部门) at the provincial level or above

obligations.summary: Cyberspace administrations, with public security authorities and other personal information protection departments, establish information sharing and notification mechanisms and jointly carry out related work.

evidence.quote: shall establish and improve mechanisms for information sharing and notification, and shall jointly carry out related work

obligations.summary: Cooperate with supervision and inspection of facial recognition processing activities in accordance with the law.

evidence.quote: Personal information processors shall cooperate in accordance with the law.

obligations.summary: Departments receiving complaints or reports on unlawful use of facial recognition must handle them promptly and in accordance with the law and notify the complainant of the outcome.

evidence.quote: Departments receiving such complaints or reports shall handle them promptly and in accordance with the law
